children.name: Datisca glomerata  Baill.
children.description: Datisca glomerata is a species of plant native to California, Nevada, and Baja California known by the common name Durango root.

children.name: Tetrameleoxylon prenudiflora Lakhnapal & Verma, 1966
children.description: A fossil dicotyledonous wood described by Lakhanpal & Verma (1966) from a piece of silicified secondary wood from the Deccan Intertrappean beds at Mohgaon Kalan, Madhya Pradesh, India. Placed in the new form-genus Tetrameleoxylon and tentatively assigned near Datiscaceae/Tetramelaceae because its wood anatomy closely matches the living tree Tetrameles nudiflora; the type locality is a Paleogene horizon.
